message: Hi, I'm a student with a r programming certification background. My overall academic average is 85% in an IT/computer-science degree. I'm interested in cloud computing and cloud computing. I want to become a Web Developer. My family can afford at most about USD 13100 per year. I live in Delhi. I'm open to going abroad. Getting a good job after graduation matters more to me than anything else.
reflection_note: The current shortlist is strong and meets all hard constraints (Budget: PR0194=$1950, PR0042=$10800, PR0001=$11850; Location/Background: All are international options requiring CS background). No immediate swaps are necessary as the current top 3 provide excellent diversity in cost and location (Germany, Canada, Netherlands) while maintaining high relevance to Cloud/SE. I recommend keeping this list.
explanation:
Aravalli School of Engineering
This program is highly recommended because it directly aligns with your stated interest in cloud computing and fits well within your maximum budget of $13,100 USD per year, with an annual tuition cost of only $1950. Since you have a strong IT/computer-science background (85%), the required CS background is easily met, and the program offers 18 months of post-study work visa time. The main trade-off here is that while the salary potential ($30,651) is high, the placement rate (67%) is lower than some other options on your shortlist.

Aravalli Institute of Applied Sciences
This option is excellent for maximizing long-term employability due to its generous 36-month post-study work visa period, which aligns with your priority for career stability. The tuition ($10,800) remains well under your budget, and the MSc Software Engineering focus supports your goal as a Web Developer. The trade-off is that while it offers the longest stay in Canada, its median starting salary of $29,138 is slightly lower than the German option.

Meridian University
This program is ideal because it directly addresses your interest in cloud computing and boasts the highest placement rate (73%) among all options. The annual tuition ($11,850) fits comfortably within your budget, and the lack of a strict CS background requirement offers flexibility while still providing relevant skills for web development. However, the main trade-off is that its post-study work visa period is only 12 months, which is shorter than the options in Canada or Germany.
